phase14._source: fraud/RESULTS-IEEE-AMOUNT.md, Good customers declined. Logreg with two lines, then with the rule.

nilson._source: ../midterm-proposal/PLAN.md, References [1]: The Nilson Report, "Card fraud losses worldwide in 2023," no. 1276, Dec. 2024. Documented.

data._source: fraud/DATA.md (PaySim: 6,362,620 rows, 8,213 fraud, steps 1-743 = 31 days; one fraud in 775 is 6,362,620 / 8,213 rounded); fraud/eval_ieee.py WINDOW_SIZE (rows per window). Observed; the window size is an Implementation choice.

illustration._source: Implementation choice: made-up numbers to show the mechanism on the worked PaySim payment; no rule, logistic regression or tree scored this payment, and the slides label these numbers 'illustration'. Derived values are computed from these, worked.amount and costs (friction 10%, at least 1 USD; review fee 10 USD): rule.big.approve = p x 305,369.89, rule.big.decline = (1 - p) x 30,536.99, rule.review = fee + lam; logreg.log_amount.x = ln(305,369.89) rounded, logreg.p = 1 / (1 + e^1.08); trees.p = 1 / (1 + e^1.80).
